title: BRAVO SQUADRON recruiting
description: Puts a Prospect IV forward for BRAVO SQUADRON, PERMAFLEET's fighter squadron (offered by the recruiting campaign in contracts/recruiting.json). Answers are recorded per member for PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who joins.

welcome.say: Hi {{user.name}}! Your answers go to PERMAFLEET leadership, who select who joins **BRAVO SQUADRON**. Nothing is sent until you confirm at the end, and Cancel stops at any point.

experience.say: How much dogfighting have you done?

options.label: PvP
options.description: I hold my own against players

ships.say: What do you like to fly? Pick everything that fits.

fnf.say: Official BRAVO training runs on **Friday Night Fights**. Can you make it?

when.say: When do you usually play (your local time)? Pick everything that fits.

handle.say: What's your RSI handle? It's the name in your RSI profile link (robertsspaceindustries.com/citizens/<handle>).

application.say: Have you filled out the squadron application? One application covers every squadron, and it's also required to join G00N SQUAD: {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons#squadron-apply

notes.say: Anything leadership should know? Past squadrons or orgs, clips, tournament results, a wingman who can vouch for you. Skip if not.

complete.say: Sent. PERMAFLEET leadership reviews every name and selects who joins BRAVO SQUADRON; you'll hear from them on Discord. Until then, fly Friday Night Fights and log your duels with `/1v1`: {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/resources/1v1-leaderboard

cancelled.say: No problem, nothing was sent. When you're ready, the squadron application is at {{context.siteUrl|https://goon.vc}}/operations/PERMAFLEET/squadrons#squadron-apply
